reviews.title: Free to download but pay to access
reviews.text: Apps like this I consider a scam. By all means lock some features behind a paywall or subscription, but don’t allow it to be downloaded for free and then be completely useless without payment. If I can google the recipe on the same website for free, why would I pay for the app version? Disgraceful.

reviews.title: Recipie free on the website but charged in app?

reviews.title: Since when does in ap purchasing mean you HAVE to pay to use this app. Just be clear!!!
reviews.text:
You can search for dishes without subscribing and see their picture. However you can’t see ingredients or methods. I’ll just stick to googling recipes thanks. 

Ps thanks for also starting with the set up account bit first and then go into the subscription section after. Glad you wasted my time and took my email address. Oh wait.. this is exactly why I got back on here to give you the 1 star. 

I get not everything in life is free.. but you should be more clear about the costs straight off the bat.

I’m reply to your our website has free recipes— no it doesn’t Iv clicked on a link and been asked to accept cookies or pay to enter…. Sooooo not free? You ask for something in return. Luckily for me I can just go back and click on someone else link and find a good recipe there.

reviews.title: Recipe collections doesn’t work
reviews.text:
The app has plenty of recipes but you do have to search around, otherwise you are shown the same recipe or collection on the home page/suggested. 

However, the biggest annoyance is the recipe collections do not work. You cannot add a recipe into a collection if you have multiple recipe collections, because you cannot scroll down to select the recipe collection, it just pings back to the top meaning you can only add the recipe into the top 3 recipe collections. I logged a ticket 3 weeks ago, my app and software is up date. All they have done is ask me to log in again and make sure it’s up to date. It’s a genuine bug that needs fixing. I feel annoyed I’ve spent £25 a year and I can’t save recipes into collections which make it easier to find again.

reviews.title: It’s an insult to charge for this
reviews.text: The amount of inaccuracies in the recipes is just getting ridiculous now. The amount the recipes serve and cooking times are regularly wrong. The recipe methods frequently make no sense and makes me wonder who they have writing these recipes. Then there’s the search function which is useless. When I enter foods into the dietary exclusion list it shows me recipes with the same ingredients I’ve just asked it to exclude??? The app frequently freezes, cuts out and deletes my saved recipes sometimes even my account and customer service is non existent! There seems to be no one monitoring the app at all which is clear by all the spam and annoying comments there are on the recipes. You would think that something connected to the BBC would be much better than this but I guess not. They have a cheek asking for paid subscriptions to this app. I guess they are just trading on the BBC name and the guest recipe contributors instead of the actual quality and working of the app.  I’m not that shocked, standards and customer respect levels are hitting rock bottom everywhere.

reviews.title: Recipes are nothing special no worth the cost
reviews.text: I am disappointed by this app. I had a subscription. To try out. Would be better if you could add what you have in your fridge pantry & the either suggest recipes based on that . Or give you a more dynamic way to substitute  based on what food you have . Or allow to add update the recipe. Based on your preference , your own twist and allow you to save and update the recipe. Love to say the Recipes are special & worth the extra cost .  3 months they are Very hit and miss . Can be quite bland . No point saving recipes in this app as when you stop the subscription your loose access to recipes .   Even though you paid to see them. They are not new recipes. So if you do want to use them again write it down  😉.. this could be developed to be an amazing app.  Not there yet

reviews.title: Paid Rubbish
reviews.text:
Downloaded with the assumption that accessing recipes I can view for free on the Good Food website would also be free. I was wrong.

Making people fund an app that has no additional content to the site you already run funded by the British people’s money is ridiculous. Do better.

reviews.title: Unusable & hidden fees!
reviews.text: You can download the app and search for recipes but you can’t actually look at the recipe without paying for a subscription!!! For a recipe that you can view in the browser without having to pay!!! What is the point in offering an app that paywalls something that’s free online? Makes absolutely no sense! I understand having the subscription for extra features and even having some premium recipes locked but not being able to see basic information for recipes that are free online and suggest you use the app is a capitalist con. If you are looking for a handy app to find and read recipes this is not it!!! Just use the website on your phone or tablet browser. Absolute waste of storage!

reviews.title: Hidden behind a paywall- Don’t bother trying it
reviews.text: Downloaded the app as I use the website a lot for meal ideas. It’s incredibly frustrating that you think it’s ok to charge people for an app when the information is already available for free on your website. I wouldn’t have minded if you had actually stated somewhere on the website links that a subscription was required to do more than search for recipes. If you had made it clear about the subscription, I wouldn’t have wasted my time downloading it and getting frustrated while making dinner.

reviews.title: Might need to unsubscribe
reviews.text: I have a digital subscription, but for it to be worth it to me, I need to be able to use it with my Paprika app. So far it isn’t going well. Any suggestions?

reviews.title: Dreadful
reviews.text: I have given up bothering to try actually get in and activate the app. Did a gift sub for husband. I have access to both emails i.e mine the one I bought sub with and his the one i sent sub too. Something has gotten seriously mixed up. I have emails both sides to confirm gift and receipt. It will not activate the sub. I have spoken to customer service three times. Though I say service exceptionally lightly. They are rude and short on the phone. Each one of them  telling me conflicting reasons why this isn’t working and what should be done. Therefore they clearly don’t know. Whilst at the same time presuming I am completely thick and can’t possibly have tried all different methods to solve this issue myself. I am disgusted if I’m honest just how appalling this service has proven to be. The only saving grace is I bought the print and digital sub. The fact that the magazine should come in March means I have accepted I won’t access the app and the mags at the price I paid were actually good value. So I’m willing to forget using the app. Thank god that the sub doesn’t auto renew so I won’t have that to deal with too.
